name: Beretvale
summary: Melbourne operating company behind the HoloHost then Nella Networks ISP (Beretvale Pty Ltd); associated with the R B Allen Family Trust; Nella Telecommunications separated out c.2004, Beretvale later deregistered.

events.details: Beretvale Pty Ltd ran the HoloHost ISP from c.1998, so the company predates the 24 Mar 2000 R B Allen Family Trust ABN.

HoloHost/Nella Networks became Nella Telecommunications, which separated out from Beretvale c.2004; Beretvale later deregistered. Proposal confirmed: the Beretvale/Nella ISP web presence last stood as a retail Nella Telecommunications homepage on 15 Jun 2005 (ABN footer matches) and was a Plesk placeholder by 5 Nov 2005, with the domain turning to the unrelated Comvergence by Feb 2007 - death by Nov 2005 (site-gone), replacing the too-early c.2004.

refs.label: Last retail homepage of the Beretvale-successor Nella Telecommunications operation (SmartVoice VoIP plus internet services T&Cs), 15 Jun 2005 - current c.2004 i
By 5 Nov 2005 the ISP web presence was gone (Plesk placeholder), exactly the proposal's bracket.
From Feb 2007 the domain hosted Comvergence, a different company (founded 2005); non-Nella survival on the domain does not extend Beretvale/Nella's death.
Corporate/administrative wind-up trails the web-presence death by ~3 years; site-level evidence (placeholder Nov 2005) governs the 2005 death.

events.details: ABN 93 132 994 466 (cited for Beretvale) is on ABR THE R B ALLEN FAMILY TRUST, a discretionary investment trust in VIC active from 24 Mar 2000 — the associated family trust, not the company Beretvale Pty Ltd itself.
